verdict.rationale: An authenticator or password manager could plausibly offer in-product AI-generated insights, such as security suggestions about stored items, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside 2FAS. The agent-facing llms.txt and markdown docs only help external AI agents read documentation, which is an adjacent feature and does not deliver in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
